Name: Kruger S-65 Stingray
Description:
Manufacturer: Kruger Intergalactic
Focus: Medium Fighter

Sleek, balanced, and uncompromising in its vision, the S-65 Stingray is a medium fighter that balances great maneuverability whilst still packing a punch. Taking after its namesake, the Stingray is no stranger to combat, able to swoop in, deliver sustained damage, and swoop out, unafraid to take a few hits in the process.
